## G — Driving records, suspensions and reinstatement
Completion index for Driving records, suspensions and reinstatement: the knowledge and continuation chunks contain the source-bound rules, conditions and distinctions. The accuracy chunk keeps unverified or dynamic claims as debt.
The exact missed-question allowance is sourced in A; percentage and time-limit values stay unknown. Demand and competitive research are unresolved in their respective chunks.

corpus_stability.reason: Corpus is the frozen July handbook snapshot; future issuer changes require a new source registration, rather than silent updates to this corpus.

verification_debt.claim_text: Demand evidence for Driving records, suspensions and reinstatement remains unresolved.
Competitor evidence for Driving records, suspensions and reinstatement remains unresolved.

All driving-record, point, GDL and suspension consequences in these mapped pages are source descriptions from the staged handbook. Current statutory scope, exceptions and amendments have not passed the reserved legal review; current-law release remains blocked.

The Traffic Safety Education Course rule begins on physical page one hundred twenty-three and continues onto one hundred twenty-four. Its full conditions include a maximum four-point reduction, an officer's offer and driver acceptance at citation, completion within forty-five days and removal tied to that citation's points. The complete multi-page rule is withheld rather than omitting its deadline.

The ALS, refusal, court-review and interlock rules on physical pages one hundred twenty-five through one hundred twenty-seven need current legal verification, including the blanket all-ALS interlock wording and interaction with absolute suspensions. Source conditions are preserved; no broader eligibility is inferred.

The reinstatement paragraph on physical page one hundred twenty-seven ends mid-sentence and continues onto one hundred twenty-eight. Applying and paying source-described fees do not constitute a complete reinstatement checklist; the continuation needs a supported multi-page binding.

The handbook's twenty-five-through-two-hundred-eighty-five-dollar reinstatement range and possible multiple fees are not verified against a current official schedule. Do not quote a current payable amount or guarantee restoration from payment alone.

Exact missed-question allowance; no inferred percentage.

Removing points does not erase a conviction. An administrative suspension is separate from criminal proceedings. A restricted permit is possible only when eligible, not an automatic exception to an absolute suspension.
Trigger, period and permission is a learning cue for comparing the supported consequence rules.
ALS means administrative license suspension; an absolute suspension permits no driving; an ignition interlock checks a breath sample before engine starting.
